newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil prices notionally stable.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil prices notionally stable.

text.p: NWE straight run fuel oil prices remained notionally stable on Wednesday with Brent's technical rally stalling the market, traders said.
Offers of $108 and $107 a tonne fob NWE were heard with sellers saying they had ample material.
One seller heard a bid of $106 for good quality low sulphur straight run but said he could afford to reject it. He added that interest from across the Atlantic was good.
No cargoes were seen sold today though one seller reported a sale of low sulphur material earlier this week, loading in the third decade of March, at an undisclosed price.
Russian high sulphur cargoes were still on offer in Baltic ports, traders said.
